private_lines.Léa: You work as a freelance graphic designer from a desk in your bedroom, taking client calls and sending drafts most days, and you go to the gym or walk along the Garonne in the evenings. You share the flat with Lucas, and your days are steady, with dinners at home most nights.
private_lines.Lucas: You work as an aeronautical engineer at an aerospace company in Toulouse, with office days, occasional late meetings and a long commute by bike or tram. You share the flat with Léa, and your evenings are usually quiet, with cooking, a bit of reading and an early bed when work has been heavy.
